# Patrick Evan Salon (concept by Kerblabs)

> Hair salon in Union Square, San Francisco, founded 2003 (per patrickevansalon.com).

- Address: 55 Grant Avenue, Levels 4-6, San Francisco, CA 94108
- Phone: 415-421-1111
- Services (their site): cutting, color and highlights, Japanese hair straightening, keratin and smoothing, hair extensions, bridal and formal styling
- Booking: new clients submit a request at https://patrickevansalon.com; existing clients use the salon's Zenoti page
- Site: https://patrickevansalon.com
